text:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — proposal: introduce a 'soft-pin' model state + per-tenant TTL to make catalog migrations gradual and reversible. High-level ask: let tenants opt into a deprecated model fallback for X days, with automatic unpin after TTL and an audit trail. Looking for engineering constraints and launch criteria.

Jonah (Eng-ML): Quick Q: how do we define the smoke benchmark to assert parity? latency+generation-quality or only perf? Also need a canary harness for per-tenant inference sampling.

Priya (Eng Platform): From infra POV soft-pin sounds fine, but we need: (1) per-tenant routing key, (2) TTL metadata on pin object, (3) fallback policy precedence (pin > route > global). Also watch cache/kv invalidation.

Carlos (Customer Success): Customers will love a reversible path. Ask: add an "opt-in migration" API so customers can request a cutover window and receive a migration report afterward. Also need comms template.

Ava (SRE): Concern: rollback blast radius. We need explicit rollout gates + automated rollback triggers (errors, latency regressions). Observability: token-level cost and p95 per-tenant for the canary.

Maya (PM): Good points — proposed launch criteria (first draft):
```
- Bench parity: quality delta <= 1% (eval set), perf: P50 <= 120ms, P95 <= 350ms at typical batch sizes
- Canary: 0.5%-2% traffic for 72h with error rate < 0.5% and no quality regressions
- TTL semantics: pin TTL configurable per-tenant, default 14 days, automatic unpin + comms after expiry
- Rollback: automated rollback if canary error rate spike > 2x baseline or latency P95 > 2x baseline
- Audit: change history stored, who/when/reason, and customer-facing migration report
```

Jonah (Eng-ML): Suggest adding a lightweight smoke harness command we can run in CI / on-demand:
```bash
# run the smoke bench for model X on tenant sample set
curl -sS -X POST https://bench.internal/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BENCH_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"m-psi-1","seq":256,"prompts":["sample1","sample2"],"runs":30}'
```
This should output p50/p95/quality-delta. We can gate canaries on it.

Priya (Eng Platform): Implementation notes: store pin as metadata on catalog entry: {tenant_id, model_id, pin_type:soft, expires_at, created_by}. We'll need a migration path for tenants with legacy pins. Also rate-limiter interactions: soft-pinned requests must still respect tenant quotas.

Ava (SRE): Add monitoring checklist: per-tenant traces, daily regression alert, rolling panic button that flips traffic back to previous model within 5s. Who owns the panic button? ops.

Liam (Sales): Two asks from field: (1) customers want an "extended TTL" paid opt-in (30/60 days), (2) we need a short explainer + sample SLA language for renewals. Can Customer Success own the comm package?

Carlos (Customer Success): Yes, we can own templates. Also propose a customer migration report including: pre/post benchmark numbers, lost tokens due to retries, and suggested knob adjustments.

Maya (PM): Next steps / owners: Jonah -> prototype smoke bench + gate (ETA 2w); Priya -> schema + routing changes + migration shim (ETA 3w); Ava -> monitoring + rollback automation (ETA 2w); Carlos -> comms + report template (ETA 1w); Liam -> field pricing proposal for TTL extensions (ETA 1w). I'll consolidate into a short RFC and PRD.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: canary/softpin-smoke-1 (runs nightly).

Jonah (Eng-ML): :thumbsup: I'll kick off the bench harness and drop a PR link here when available.

Priya (Eng Platform): Noted. Will prototype migration shim that accepts legacy pins and converts to soft-pin TTL.

Maya (PM): Great. If anyone sees a blocker to these timelines, flag it here by EOD. Thanks all. :sparkles:
